legal.privacyPolicy:
Data Controller: Adrián Carrasco López. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Purpose: management of wedding invitations, confirmation of attendance, and communication of events. 

Legal basis: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR). Health data (allergies and food intolerances) is processed with explicit consent (Art. 9.2.a GDPR) to adapt the celebration menu.

Data collected: Expected guest list: the organizer may add a list of names (expected guests) for attendance control; this data is only visible to the organizer and follows the same retention policy. Demonstrable consent: RSVP and cookie preferences are recorded with date and policy version. Access and audit: for security and traceability purposes (legitimate interest), attempts to access the organizer panel and configuration changes (date, type of action, and technical device data) are recorded. name, dietary preferences (allergies and intolerances), voluntarily uploaded images, bank details if voluntarily provided, date of birth (only to validate age for minor RSVP), technical browser data (user-agent) upon confirming attendance, and, if you participate in the social functions of the invitation (dedications, songs, itineraries, gift reservations), your name and the message you provide, which are VISIBLE to the rest of the guests.

Recipients: Google LLC (Firebase, Google Cloud Platform) based in the US. Google has subscribed to the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission (Decision 2021/914) and has a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with Art. 28 GDPR. Furthermore, Google complies with the EU-US, UK-US, and Switzerland-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF), a certification that guarantees an adequate level of protection for international data transfers.

International transfers: data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Europe, Frankfurt). When data needs to be transferred to the US, the transfer is covered by the SCC and Google's DPF certification.

Retention period: guest data is kept for up to 12 months after the event date. After this period, guest data is deleted by the service administrator (who has a cleanup function in their panel) and, in any case, is not kept for more than 12 months. You can also request its early deletion. You can request early deletion at any time by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Creator configuration data is kept for up to 12 months after the event date or as long as the account is active, whichever comes first; its deletion is executed by the service administrator.

Rights: you can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, limitation, portability, and objection by writing to adriancl2001@gmail.com. Guests can request the deletion of their data by indicating their name and the invitation. We will respond to your request within a maximum period of 30 days.

Right to withdraw consent: you can withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal will not affect the lawfulness of processing based on prior consent.

Minors: we do not collect data from minors under 14 years of age consciously. If the data subject is under 14 years of age (or the equivalent age according to the country of residence: 14 in Spain, 16 in Germany, etc.), the consent of their parents or legal guardians is required.

Automated decisions: no automated decisions are made based on your data.

Consequences of not providing data: if you do not provide your personal data, we will not be able to manage your confirmation of attendance.

DPO: this website does not require a Data Protection Officer according to Art. 37 GDPR as the conditions of Art. 37.1 are not met. However, you can contact the controller at any time.

GDPR Claims (EU/EEA): you can file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) or with the supervisory authority of your EU member country.

UK GDPR: for residents in the UK, the data controller undertakes to comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Google complies with the EU-US DPF UK Extension, and the SCC have been adopted by the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) as a valid transfer mechanism. You can file a complaint with the ICO (https://ico.org.uk).

LGPD (Brazil): for residents in Brazil, the data controller undertakes to comply with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD – Law No. 13.709/2018). Google complies with the requirements for international transfer of LGPD. Controller (DPO): same controller. Contact: adriancl2001@gmail.com. Rights according to Art. 18 LGPD: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization/blocking/erasure, portability, information on sharing, withdrawal of consent, review of automated decisions, objection.

CCPA/CPRA (California): for residents in California (US), you have the right to:
- Know what categories of personal data we collect and for what purpose.
- Request the deletion of your personal data.
- Opt out of the sale of your personal data (we do not sell personal data).
- Not be discriminated against for exercising your CCPA rights.
To exercise these rights, write to adriancl2001@gmail.com.

PIPEDA (Canada): for residents in Canada, we comply with the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act. PIPEDA Principles: accountability (Adrián Carrasco López), identification of purposes, consent, limitation of collection, limitation of use/disclosure/retention, accuracy, safeguards, transparency, individual access, possibility of complaint. Mandatory breach notification to the OPC.

POPIA (South Africa): for residents in South Africa, we comply with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA). We collect your data with your consent for specific purposes. Conditions for cross-border transfers (Section 72 POPIA): data is transferred to Google LLC (US) which offers an adequate level of protection through SCC and DPF. The controller guarantees that the recipient applies processing principles similar to those of POPIA. You can file a complaint with the Information Regulator (South Africa).

Security breach response plan: in the event of a personal data breach, Wedingo will notify the competent supervisory authority within a maximum period of 72 hours (GDPR Art. 33). If the breach poses a high risk to the rights and freedoms of the data subjects, they will be notified without undue delay (GDPR Art. 34). Notifications will be made by email to the provided contact address.

Local storage: this site uses local storage. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers without your consent or action: the map and translation only activate when clicked. Local storage: this site uses local storage (localStorage and sessionStorage) only for essential functions: keeping your session logged in and caching the invitation configuration. We do not use third-party cookies or trackers. By continuing to browse, you consent to the use of this necessary technical storage.

Technical storage and cache (PWA): Wedingo uses a service worker (/sw.js) that preloads application resources (JavaScript, CSS, and fonts) to speed up loading and allow basic offline use. These resources are stored in the device's browser cache and do not contain your personal data. You can clear this cache from your browser settings at any time.

Analytics and error monitoring: with your consent (Statistics option), Wedingo uses Google Analytics (Google LLC) to measure the anonymous use of the invitation and Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., with DPA and Standard Contractual Clauses) to detect and correct errors. These services only receive data if you accept this option in the cookie banner; they are not activated without consent. Furthermore, if the invitation includes a map, the Google Maps view only loads when clicked (load on click): the map may issue Google cookies only at that moment and by your action.

Translation: the 'Translate' function uses the free Google widget (Google LLC) and only activates if the user requests it; the invitation text is sent to Google only at that moment (processor covered by SCC and DPF). Optional contact: if the guest authorizes it (specific checkbox), their phone or email is saved only for event logistics and is only visible to the organizer; it can be requested to be deleted at any time.

legal.legalText:
In compliance with Article 10 of Law 34/2002, of July 11, on the Services of the Information Society and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), it is hereby informed:

Controller: Adrián Carrasco López
Email: adriancl2001@gmail.com
Purpose of the website: personalized wedding invitation platform.

This website uses Firebase (Google LLC) as hosting and storage infrastructure, with servers in the European Union.
legal.cookiesPolicy:
This platform uses the following cookies and storage technologies:

• Strictly necessary storage: your language and accessibility preference, and the configuration/admin session (sessionStorage). No personal data is saved in the browser without your consent.

• Local storage (localStorage) and IndexedDB: temporarily store the invitation content (texts, images, and AES-GCM encrypted audio) so that it loads faster and is viewable offline. Only used if you accept storage; if you reject it, the invitation is displayed in session mode (without persistence) and saved data is deleted.

• Third-party services (only after your consent): Google Analytics and Sentry (statistics and error diagnosis). Sentry session replay records the session only if you accept analytics and does not record your credentials.

• On-demand actions (without prior consent, by your click): Google Maps to display the invitation map and the Google translation widget. Using them sends your data to those services according to their own policies.

• Service worker: caches the static resources necessary for the app to work offline, without personal data.

You can configure or withdraw your consent at any time from the cookie notice. Duration: necessary for the indicated purposes (invitation data is deleted 12 months after the wedding or sooner if requested).

compliance.title: Ukuqhuba kwezenzo zokulalela (Art. 30 GDPR)
compliance.updated: Liphuculwe: Agasti 2026. Lo mqondo ukhomba izenzo zokulalela amakhasimende anomuntu ku-Wedingo.
compliance.row1Data: Igama lomakoti, usuku, indawo, isihloko, izithombe, umculo, ukudla, izigaba
compliance.row2Data: Igama lommoya, ukufika (yebo/chazanga), ukukhetha ukudla, izifo, idatha yempilo
compliance.row4Purpose: Control access to the administration panel
compliance.row5Data: Acciones de superadmin, tokens usados, invitaciones eliminadas
compliance.internationalText: Data is stored on Google Cloud servers in the eur3 region (Frankfurt, Germany). Google LLC (USA) acts as the data processor under DPA according to Art. 28 GDPR. Transfers to the USA are covered by:
compliance.dpf: Data Privacy Framework (DPF) UE-EE.UU., UK-EE.UU. y Suiza-EE.UU.
compliance.measureEncryption: AES-256-GCM encryption of images and sensitive data (PBKDF2)
compliance.measureFirestore: Reglas de seguridad en Firestore (control de acceso basado en sesiones)
compliance.measureStorage: Minimum local storage and only with consent
compliance.measureRetention: Retention policy: 12 months post-event for guest data
compliance.measureSuperadmin: Superadmin protegido por Firebase Authentication + ruta oculta
compliance.templatesHelp: Summaries ready to adapt and copy into the privacy policy of each invitation.

animations.sectionHint: Khetha ukuthi yizimihambisi ezibalulekile ezihamba ku-invitation, kusuka esandleni kuya kumaziphakeme. Ikhadi elikhethiwe kusho ukuthi izimihambisi ziyawufakwa; khomba leyo ofuna ukuyihlanganisa kubo bonke abakhethiwe.

envelope-flap.name: Ukovula isigaba se-ensibhata
envelope-flap.hint: Ekokuqala kokuthinta, isigaba se-ensibhata sivule ngokugqama kwe-3D. Ukulungiselela kususa kuwamukela ngokusho okumbalwa.

envelope-lights.name: Izibane zokukhanya kuvala esibhathweni
envelope-lights.hint: Izibane ezithathu zokukhanya zihamba kuvala esibhathweni lapho sikhona, zikunika ukukhanya okumnandi.

envelope-flash.name: Ukukhanya okuhlaza lapho ku-open
envelope-flash.hint: Ukukhanya okuhlaza okuhlaza esikrini kuqhuba ukushintsha ngokushesha ngemuva kokuvula isigaba se-ensibhata.

envelope-golden-text.name: Ulimi oluhlaza lokwamukela
envelope-golden-text.hint: Umyalezo ouhlaza ukhula ngenkungu lapho kuvulwa isigaba se-ensibhata futhi uyaqeda lapho kuya. Ngaphandle kwalo, lo myalezo awubonakali.

envelope-hint-pulse.name: Ukugcwaliswa komyalezo 'Thinta ukuze uvule'
envelope-hint-pulse.hint: Ulimi lokusiza olukhombisa ukuthi kungani kuvulwa isigaba se-ensibhata luhlala lukhala lapo ukuvusa.

envelope-letter-fade.name: Ukungqopha kwicandelo esandleni
envelope-letter-fade.hint: Icandelo esandleni se-ensibhata lungqopha lapho kuvulwa isigaba se-ensibhata ukuze kubonakale umyalezo.

envelope-overlay-fade.name: Ukungqopha kokuhamba kwe-ensibhata
envelope-overlay-fade.hint: Lapho kuqedile, isigaba se-ensibhata esiphelele lungqopha (ukukhanya nokungqopha) ukuze kubonakale umyalezo.

confetti-fall.name: Imvula yengconfeti lapho kuvulwa
confetti-fall.hint: Ibhizinisi leconfeti eliningi elizihamba lapho kuya ngaphansi kwesihloko, njengokugubha.

welcome-video-modal.name: Ukungena nokuhamba kwebhizinisi lokwamukela
welcome-video-modal.hint: Isakhiwo lapho kuqhuba ibhizinisi lokwamukela sibonakala futhi singahamba ngezindleko ezilula kanye nokungqopha.

decoration-sway.name: Ukuhamba kwezincabhuko ze-eucalyptus
decoration-sway.hint: Izincabhuko zezigcabhuko ezihlanganiswe zihamba ngokuthula, njengokuthi zivuvulwe yiziwethu, ngenkathi yonke inhlahla.

decoration-float.name: Ukuhamba kwezincabhuko
decoration-float.hint: Ukuhamba okungqopha okubanzi kwezincabhuko zezigcabhuko ngenkathi usekaphakathi kwazo.

story-transitions.name: Ukushintsha phakathi kwezincabhuko
story-transitions.hint: Lapho ukhamba, yonke inhlahla ingqopha, ihamba futhi ishintsha ukukhanya lapho isondela noma lapho ishale phakathi kwesikrini.

story-reveal.name: Ukungena kwe-3D kwicandelo lapho kuya
story-reveal.hint: Lapho isigaba se-ensibhata sivulwa, isakhiwo sokuqala singena ngenkungu ye-3D emincane kanye nokungqopha okungqopha.

story-smooth-scroll.name: Ukuhamba okuthule
story-smooth-scroll.hint: Ukuhamba phakathi kwezincabhuko kuphakathi kwezincabhuko kuphakathi kwezincabhuko ngokuhamba okuthule esikhundleni sokuhamba ngokushesha.

story-snap.name: Ukuzigcina kwemincabhuko
story-snap.hint: Lapho ukhamba lapho udinga inhlahla, inhlahla ihamba ngayo ukuze ihlale phakathi kwesikrini.

story-hover.name: Ukugcwala kwicandelo lapho kuphathwa imanyathelo
story-hover.hint: Isakhiwo esisebenza singcwala kancane ngenkungu lapho uphatha imanyathelo ngaphomba.

fireflies.name: Ukuhamba kwezifutshi
fireflies.hint: Ibhizinisi lezifutshi eziningi zihamba kancane ngaphansi kwesikrini.

music-equalizer.name: Izibane zokuhlela
music-equalizer.hint: Izibane ezithathu zihamba njengokuhlela esikhundleni semculo lapho ingoma isadlala.

music-fab-pulse.name: Ukugcwaliswa komyalezo womculo
music-fab-pulse.hint: Isibane esingqopha sivukela isikhundleni esingqopha semculo lapho sidlala.

music-card-open.name: Apertura del reproductor
music-card-open.hint: The music player panel unfolds with a soft scale when the button is pressed.

music-icon-bounce.name: Music icon bounce
music-icon-bounce.hint: El icono de la nota musical rebota al abrir o cerrar el reproductor.

music-fab-shift.name: Music button displacement
music-fab-shift.hint: The floating button moves to the side when opening the player so as not to cover it.

music-dot-blink.name: Music notification point
music-dot-blink.hint: El punto que avisa de un error o del estado del audio parpadea suavemente.

music-play-glow.name: Play button halo
music-play-glow.hint: The player's play or pause button emits a halo that pulses softly.

music-spinner.name: Music loading wheel
music-spinner.hint: A wheel spins on the button while the song is loading.

music-fab-hover.name: Music button scale
music-fab-hover.hint: The floating button slightly enlarges when hovered over.

music-status-shake.name: Music error shake
music-status-shake.hint: The loading error message shakes to draw attention.

hero-photo-ring.name: Anillo dorado de la foto
hero-photo-ring.hint: Un anillo dorado pulsa alrededor de la foto de la pareja en la portada.

hero-godparent-glow.name: Resplandor de los padrinos
hero-godparent-glow.hint: The text with the groomsmen's names emits a warm, pulsing glow.

hero-photo-fade.name: Fundido de la foto al cargar
hero-photo-fade.hint: La foto de la portada aparece con un fundido suave cuando termina de cargar.

countdown-tick.name: Cuenta regresiva en directo
countdown-tick.hint: The remaining time counter updates every second. When deactivated, the static initial value is shown.

loading-spinner.name: Ruedas de carga
loading-spinner.hint: Las ruedas giratorias que aparecen mientras cargan la foto de la portada y otros contenidos.

gallery-blur.name: Cambio de foto con desenfoque
gallery-blur.hint: When navigating the gallery, the previous photo blurs while the new one enters sharply.

gallery-caption.name: Entrance of each photo description
gallery-caption.hint: The description of each photo appears with a small upward slide.

gallery-lightbox.name: Apertura del visor de fotos
gallery-lightbox.hint: The full-screen gallery viewer appears with an entrance fade.

gallery-thumb-hover.name: Escala de las miniaturas
gallery-thumb-hover.hint: Gallery thumbnails slightly enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-nav-hover.name: Gallery arrow scale
gallery-nav-hover.hint: Gallery navigation arrows enlarge when hovered over.

gallery-auto-advance.name: Automatic carousel advance
gallery-auto-advance.hint: The gallery advances from photo to photo every 5 seconds. When deactivated, it only changes when the arrows are pressed.

button-hover.name: Button elevation
button-hover.hint: The invitation buttons (RSVP, share, send...) lift slightly with a shadow when hovered over.

reaction-hover.name: Escala de las reacciones
reaction-hover.hint: The reaction buttons (❤️ 🎉 😂) slightly enlarge when hovering over them.

theme-glow-depth.name: Resplandor del fondo
theme-glow-depth.hint: A glow of light slowly runs across the background of the invitation, giving a sense of depth.

landing-pulse.name: Pulso de las pantallas de carga
landing-pulse.hint: El fondo de las pantallas de carga, error y mantenimiento pulsa suavemente.

toast-animations.name: Avisos flotantes
toast-animations.hint: Los avisos breves (confirmaciones, errores...) aparecen y desaparecen con un deslizamiento.

animations.allOffHint: When activated, the invitation is displayed without any animation: the envelope does not appear, there is no confetti or transitions. When deactivated, your individual preferences return.
